'''Interrogation''' was a department within the [[Intentions]] branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Charged with the questioning of captured prisoners, Interrogation maintained a fully equipped laboratory with both the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] and the [[Alliance Headquarters]]. Each [[Sector/Legends|sector]] base also had at least one Interrogation officer as part of its staff.<ref name="RASB" />

Interrogation officers did not employ the harsh methods used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Interrogation (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|interrogators]]; instead they used [[Sensor/Legends|scanners]], [[Psychologist/Legends|psychologists]], undercover agents in holding cells, [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Telepathy/Legends|telepaths]], [[Truth serum/Legends|truth drugs]], and even the threat of violence to coerce their prisoners into talking. They were efficient and effective at drawing the information out of their charges.<ref name="RASB" />

Interrogation officers were usually present at important [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] meetings, disguised as aides assigned to the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government]]. These officers interpreted body language and facial expressions to determine if the other members of the delegation were lying.<ref name="RASB" />

[[Ejagga Pakkpekatt]] worked in the Interrogation section of Alliance Intelligence. There, he was assigned to the Alliance's most stubborn Imperial prisoners, where he used his [[Hortek]] telepathic abilities and intimidation skills to access information beyond standard interrogators.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
